Question: Which finding is in this chest X-ray?

Execution:
1. [task] Which finding is in this chest X-ray?
Options: {"A": "left indwelling catheter", "B": "right indwelling catheter"}
2. [action] {"calls":[{"tool":"chest_xray_expert","args":{"question":"Is there an indwelling catheter visible in this lateral chest X-ray? If so, describe its location and course relative to the spine and sternum to determine laterality."}}],"reason":"Determine presence and laterality of catheter on lateral view"}
3. [action] {"calls":[{"tool":"llava_med_qa","args":{"question":"Is there an indwelling catheter visible in this lateral chest X-ray? Describe any linear radiopaque structures and their location."}}],"reason":"Cross-validate catheter presence with independent model"}
4. [action] {"calls":[{"tool":"roi_crop","args":{"box":[0.3,0.1,0.7,0.6],"zoom":2}}],"reason":"Zoom into upper thorax to visually verify catheter presence and laterality on lateral view"}
5. [action] {"calls":[{"tool":"chest_xray_expert","args":{"question":"On this lateral chest X-ray, is there a linear radiopaque catheter visible? If yes, does it course anteriorly near the sternum (suggesting right-sided SVC entry) or posteriorly near the spine?"}}],"reason":"Determine catheter laterality by assessing anterior vs posterior course on lateral view"}
6. [action] {"calls":[{"tool":"chest_xray_expert","args":{"question":"Describe the exact course of the catheter on this lateral view: is it anterior near the sternum or posterior near the spine? This determines right vs left side."}}],"reason":"Clarify catheter position to determine laterality"}
7. [action] {"answer":"B. right indwelling catheter","reason":"Lateral view shows catheter coursing anteriorly near the sternum, consistent with right-sided SVC entry."}
8. [released_benchmark_feedback] Historical reference: B. right indwelling catheter

ABSTRACTION REQUIREMENTS:
1. Extract STRATEGY TYPES, not implementations
2. Use GENERIC terminology:
   - Say "metadata sources" NOT "JSON-LD"
   - Say "alternate access methods" NOT "Wayback Machine"
3. Focus on WHEN/WHY patterns apply
4. Brief patterns (1 sentence each)
5. Make patterns applicable to similar tasks
6. LIMIT: max 4 patterns, max 3 playbooks, max 2 checklists

Return JSON:
- "highlights": 2-3 sentence abstract summary
- "patterns": list of top 4 ABSTRACT patterns
- "playbooks": dict of up to 3 GENERAL DOMAINS -> brief tips
- "checklists": list of top 2 brief confirmation steps
